codexP2.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve non-uppercase variable names in the table fallback**

When an older Vercel CLI triggers the table-output fallback, this filter silently drops variable names containing lowercase letters or starting with an underscore. Vercel's [table renderer](https://github.com/vercel/vercel/blob/main/packages/cli/src/commands/env/ls.ts) puts `chalk.bold(env.key)` in the first column without uppercasing it. A listing containing the inventoried `EXPECTED_KEY` plus an unrecorded `legacy_key` therefore produces no problems, defeating the check for unrecorded secrets. Parse all valid variable names while excluding the table header explicitly, and add a regression test covering this case.
